definitions.name: L2D.SUM
definitions.note: Sum of a numeric Vector (0 for an empty one).

definitions.name: L2D.MEAN
definitions.body: 'MV' BIND MV 0 [ ADD ] FOLD MV LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: Arithmetic mean of a non-empty numeric Vector.

definitions.name: L2D.MOD
definitions.body: 'MB' BIND 'MA' BIND MA MA MB DIV FLOOR MB MUL SUB
definitions.note: a b -> a modulo b (a - b*floor(a/b)); lifts over Vectors in either operand.

definitions.name: L2D.COUNTT
definitions.note: Vector of truths -> how many are TRUE.

definitions.name: L2D.ABS
definitions.note: Absolute value of a number or of each element of a Vector.

definitions.name: L2D.MINV
definitions.body: 'MNV' BIND MNV MNV 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
definitions.note: Smallest element of a non-empty numeric Vector.

definitions.name: L2D.VAR
definitions.body: 'VX' BIND VX VX L2D.MEAN SUB 'VD' BIND VD VD MUL L2D.MEAN
definitions.note: Population variance of a numeric Vector (mean of squared deviations).

definitions.name: L2D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'SV' BIND SV LENGTH 'LN' BIND SV LN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET SV LN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a non-empty numeric Vector (mean of the two middle values when the count is even).

definitions.name: L2D.SUMBY
definitions.body: GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ L2D.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: keys Vector, values Vector -> Record from each key to the sum of its values, keys in order of first appearance.

definitions.name: L2D.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'CS' BIND CS 0 CS 0 GET UPPER PUT JOIN
definitions.note: Non-empty String -> first letter upper case, the rest lower case.

definitions.name: L2D.SPJOIN
definitions.body: '' [ 'W' BIND ' ' W 3 COLLECT JOIN ] FOLD TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of words -> one String joined by single spaces, no space at either end.

definitions.name: L2D.NAMES
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] entries -> Vector of the names (first elements).

definitions.name: L2D.AMTS
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] entries -> Vector of the amounts (second elements).

definitions.name: L2D.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE [ 'D' BIND DN D L2D.MOD 0 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Positive integer -> Vector of its positive divisors, ascending.

definitions.name: L2D.ISPRIME
definitions.body: 'C' BIND C 2 C RANGE L2D.MOD 1 LT L2D.COUNTT 1 EQ C 1 GT AND
definitions.note: Positive integer -> TRUE when it is prime.

definitions.name: L2D.CSTEP
definitions.body: [ 'V' 'S' ] BIND V 2 DIV V 3 MUL 1 ADD V 2 L2D.MOD 0 EQ SELECT 'NX' BIND V 1 EQ 'DONE' BIND 1 NX DONE SELECT S S 1 ADD DONE SELECT 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: Collatz state [value steps] -> next state; a value of 1 stays put and adds no step.

definitions.name: L2D.ORDERS
definitions.note: JSON String with an "orders" array -> Vector of the order Records.

definitions.name: L2D.REVENUE
definitions.body: [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'O' BIND O 'qty' GET O 'price' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> sum of qty*price over the orders that have a price.

solutions.ledger.by_name: 'IN' BIND IN L2D.NAMES IN L2D.AMTS L2D.SUMBY
solutions.ledger.top_name: 'IN' BIND IN L2D.NAMES IN L2D.AMTS L2D.SUMBY L1A.TOPKEY
solutions.ledger.debtors: 'IN' BIND IN L2D.NAMES IN L2D.AMTS L2D.SUMBY 'R' BIND R KEYS [ 'K' BIND R K GET 0 LT ] FILTER
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'IN' BIND IN IN L2D.AMTS L1A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ L2D.CAP ] MAP L2D.SPJOIN
solutions.number.binary: 'N' BIND N [ 32 16 8 4 2 1 ] DIV FLOOR 2 L2D.MOD 'BS' BIND BS BS 0 GT L1D.WHERE 0 GET DROP STR JOIN
solutions.number.collatz: 0 2 COLLECT 1 130 RANGE [ 'E' BIND L2D.CSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET
solutions.orders.unpriced: L2D.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.qty_by_sku: L2D.ORDERS 'OS' BIND OS [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OS [ 'qty' GET ] MAP L2D.SUMBY
solutions.orders.top_sku: L2D.ORDERS 'OS' BIND OS [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OS [ 'qty' GET ] MAP L2D.SUMBY L1A.TOPKEY
solutions.orders.tag_counts: L2D.ORDERS [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.series.mad: 'XS' BIND XS XS L2D.MEDIAN SUB L2D.ABS L2D.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'XS' BIND XS -2 DROP XS 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD XS 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'XS' BIND XS XS 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.stats.range: 'XS' BIND XS G0C.MAXV XS L2D.MINV SUB
solutions.stats.normalize: 'XS' BIND XS L2D.MINV 'MN' BIND XS MN SUB XS G0C.MAXV MN SUB DIV
solutions.text.acronym: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
